title: Tick
description: A timer source that fires once when the task starts, writes one text and completes.
Built for scheduled deployments: the deploy schedule's cron picks the time, the tick supplies the input, and the run ends when the pipeline drains.
Pair it with a 'prompt' lane whose saved instructions are the real input.
The text is the configured Message or, by default, the fire time in ISO 8601 UTC.

tick.text.title: Message
tick.text.description: Text written on each fire. Leave empty to send the fire time in ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-09-13T08:00:00+00:00.
